flags.message: The snapshot records a Court-appointed amicus brief defending Stinson filed August 25, 2026, but documents.json and record/documents contain no text for that brief. The available respondent merits brief is the United States' brief supporting vacatur, so both provisioned merits briefs favor disturbing the judgment. The forecast uses those briefs and the lower-court appendix but cannot directly assess the appointed opposing advocate's arguments; this limits confidence in the doctrinal forecast, not the ability to produce a prediction.
